newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan auto output up for first time in six years.
newsitem.headline: Japan auto output up for first time in six years.

text.p: Japan's vehicle output rose in the nation's latest fiscal year for the first time in six years, according to figures released Friday.

The Japan Automobile Manufacturers Association said that output in the year ended March 31 rose 5.2 percent to 10.61 million units. The rise came from robust exports and strong domestic demand ahead of an April 1 sales tax rise.
Japan' exports had started marking gains last June because of weak yen, after posting declines for 17 straight months.
Domestic sales in January through March rose sharply as consumers rushed to buy ahead of the April 1 rise in Japan's sales tax to 5 percent from 3 percent.
